text: **Bigger discovery:** a sibling worktree (`.claude/worktrees/codex+2872-wallet-builder-doc`) already had a nearly-complete, high-quality, uncommitted draft on the exact branch name I'd been told to use (`codex/2872-wallet-builder-doc`). I verified its citations were accurate (including a genuine external consumer app, `nutsack`, that I confirmed via `gh issue view 2882`) and it was more complete than my independently-written version (same conclusions, plus the `legacy_relay_hint` detail and a "validated vs. pending" status table). Rather than open a competing/duplicate PR, I adopted and finished that draft — verified every citation against source, ran the doctrine-lint smoke suite (203 passed, including the Trellis-vocabulary gate), committed, pushed, and opened the PR. I deleted my own redundant draft from my assigned worktree.
